Coram : ASHOK BHUSHAN*, M.R. SHAH, R. SUBHASH REDDY
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s.482 – Application under – Filed by an advocate claiming to be social activist – Seeking direction to expedite and conclude a criminal case u/ss. 420, 467, 468, 471, 477A and 120B IPC and s. 13(1) r/w. s. 13(2) Act – High Court allowed the petition directing the Court concerned to expedite the proceedings – Appeal to Supreme Court by the accused – Held: High Court has power to direct the trial court to expedite the criminal trial – Criminal trial in respect of offences
Decision Date : 16-12-2020 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 869/2020 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
